# TPC-Havoc Q13_v10

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c_count = 0
    THEN 0
    WHEN c_count BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    THEN c_count
    WHEN c_count BETWEEN 6 AND 10
    THEN c_count
    WHEN c_count > 10
    THEN c_count
    ELSE c_count
  END AS c_count,
  COUNT(*) AS custdist
FROM (
  SELECT
    c_custkey,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN CASE
          WHEN NOT o_comment LIKE '%special%requests%'
          THEN 1
          WHEN o_comment IS NULL
          THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END = 1
        THEN CASE WHEN NOT o_orderkey IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS c_count
  FROM customer
  LEFT OUTER JOIN orders
    ON c_custkey = o_custkey
  GROUP BY
    c_custkey
) AS c_orders
GROUP BY
  c_count
ORDER BY
  custdist DESC,
  c_count DESC
```
